During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] maintained an '''supply depot''' in the [[Rainos Cluster/Legends|Rainos Cluster]]. A [[Baas-class space station|''Baas''-class space station]], the supply depot was the target of an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Mission to the Imperial supply depot|mission]] to acquire [[KL-45 coolant hydro-valve]]s, desperately needed by the [[Obas base|Alliance base]] on [[Obas]]. The base contained a number of decks, including [[flight deck 11C]].<ref name="M" />
